steps.note: Commit the event schedule before publishing.
Add the configured QA vendor so the event can be published and bid on.
Publish the Procol event created from the PR.
Confirm the Procol event was created successfully.
Create the bid needed for the Procol award and PO flow.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Close the event so it can be awarded.
Submit the Procol award proposal to enable PO creation.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Create the Procol purchase order corresponding to the awarded PR items.
Verify the Procol PO contains the awarded PR line items and quantities.
